<thought>Template 1914395 corresponds to a trivial transformation of bromobenzene (C1=CC=CC=C1Br>>C1=CC=CC=C1Br). Applying this retrosynthetic template to the target molecule (which must be bromobenzene) yields the same molecule as the only precursor. Therefore the list of possible precursors is a single list containing the SMILES for bromobenzene.</thought>
<final_answer>[["Brc1ccccc1"]]</final_answer>
